definitions.explanation: The act of interacting with others in social settings, or the sphere of social activities and gatherings. Often used as a prefix in compound expressions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社交|しゃこう}{的|てき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He has a sociable personality and quickly becomes friends with anyone.

examples.japanese: {社交|しゃこう}ダンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{交友|こうゆう}{関係|かんけい}→交友関係：24140_kouyuukankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started learning ballroom dancing, my circle of friends has expanded.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a prefix in compounds. {社交|しゃこう}{的|てき} (sociable) is the most common derivative. {社交|しゃこう}ダンス (ballroom dancing, literally "social dance") is a well-known compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社交|しゃこう}{的|てき}: sociable, outgoing
- {社交|しゃこう}ダンス: ballroom dancing
- {社交|しゃこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: social gathering/occasion
- {社交|しゃこう}⟦{辞令|じれい}→辞令：09021_jirei⟧: polite formality, social pleasantry
